name: mcp-browser-use
description: Parent hub for three browser modes: mcp-chrome-devtools for Chrome DevTools inspection, debugging, Lighthouse audits and performance traces, mcp-aside-devtools for deterministic signed-in REPL proof, and mcp-bladebro for stealth and agentic browser work. workflowMode selects the packet through mode-registry.json and hub-router.json. mcp-code-mode is shared infrastructure and not a hub member.
